dedupe_keys.name: argentina national map of crops mapa nacional de cultivos 2024 2025 campaign

description: The Argentina National Map of Crops gives crop type maps for the main agricultural areas of Argentina, with separate winter and summer crop maps for the 2024/2025 growing season. The Zenodo record says the maps come from supervised classification of Landsat and Sentinel-2 images through the season, trained on on-road survey samples, and that a report in Spanish gives the method, legend and accuracy, with a web visualiser linked. It was published on 20 November 2025 by Diego de Abelleyra, María del Rosario Iturralde Elortegui and many co-authors as two 30 m GeoTIFFs of about 175 to 195 MB with QGIS style files, the report PDF and a preview image, downloadable and free under CC BY 4.0, with coverage of the main agricultural regions of Argentina (other seasons appear as earlier releases of the series). Caveats: minor crop areas are outside the mapped region, and accuracy varies by crop. For simulation it gives field-scale crop types for drought and flood exposure, and for grain logistics to export ports. Related catalogue records include the WRI TRAZO field boundaries for South America and the Unified Cropland Layer.
